headline: Standard Engineering Technology Limited: Addendum to Investors Presentation re Proposed Acquisition of GScale Energy Private Limited
sum: Standard Engineering Technology Limited (SETL) issued an addendum to its investor presentation on 29 June 2026 regarding the proposed acquisition of GScale Energy Private Limited, clarifying and updating material terms originally presented on 25 June 2026.
detail: SETL, a listed entity on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), disclosed an addendum to its investors' presentation dated 25 June 2026 concerning the proposed acquisition of GScale Energy Private Limited. The addendum was filed with the NSE as a regulatory disclosure on 29 June 2026. The filing does not disclose the acquisition consideration, valuation, or completion status in the headline or URL metadata; the specific amendments require access to the full PDF document. This acquisition likely involves either a strategic consolidation within the renewable/cleantech energy sector or a platform-building move for SETL. The fact that an addendum was required within four days of the initial presentation suggests either investor questions, regulatory feedback, or material term adjustments in deal structure.
